findings.evidence: runner.py:164-166 runs run_passage_rewrites on findings before drop_skipped_rules at runner.py:172. _units (rewrite.py:139-145) picks rhythm/weakener/hollow triggers regardless of skip_rules, and the emitted rule_id 'rewrite.passage' (rewrite.py:377) is not dropped. So skip_rules=['rhythm'] with rewrites=True still costs LLM calls and returns rewrites for skipped notes.
findings.message: ghostcopyeditor/pipeline/runner.py:145–159 — Callers using skip_rules can still receive rewrites triggered by skipped findings. Failure: a skipped rhythm, weakener, or hollow note can cause a rewrite before the note is removed.
